questions.title: Which broad demand component will contribute most to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth in April–June 2026?
questions.background: Japan's Cabinet Office publishes quarterly GDP estimates, including a breakdown of demand components' contributions to growth.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Cabinet Office's August 2026 release of Japan's April–June 2026 GDP estimates. Use that release's figures rather than subsequent revisions. Resolution Date : 2026-08-17 Accepted Answer Format : Resolve to the top-level demand component with the largest percentage-point contribution to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth for April–June 2026. Answer with the component's standard name.

questions.title: To which hospital will Pakistan’s Supreme Court order Imran Khan transferred for medical care in August 2026?
questions.background: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan is imprisoned at Adiala jail. His eye condition has required specialist treatment, and concerns about his health have been central to his party’s campaign for his release.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Supreme Court’s order or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations describing its requirements. Resolution : Resolve to the hospital designated in the Supreme Court’s next order, issued after the start date and during August 2026, directing Khan’s transfer from Adiala jail for hospital care. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the hospital.

questions.title: Which commodity category will record the largest monthly percentage price increase in the FAO Food Price Index for August 2026?
questions.background: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) publishes a monthly index tracking international prices across major food commodity categories.
questions.resolution_criteria: Resolve to the commodity category with the largest percentage price increase from July to August 2026, as reported in the FAO's September 2026 Food Price Index release. Resolution Date: 2026-09-04 Answer with the category name.

questions.title: Which Southeast Asian country will declare a state of emergency over wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026?
questions.background: Seasonal wildfire smoke can cross borders in Southeast Asia, creating public-health risks and prompting emergency government responses.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official national government announcements, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the country whose national authorities announce a formal state of emergency because of wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026, inclusive. The declaration may cover the entire country or a specific area within it. Air-quality warnings, school closures, or health advisories without a formal emergency declaration do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The country’s common English name.

questions.title: Which DRC province will WHO identify as experiencing a surge in weekly Ebola cases in mid-September 2026?
questions.background: The Democratic Republic of Congo declared an Ebola outbreak in May 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : WHO public statements about the DRC Ebola outbreak, including statements quoted in contemporaneous reputable news reporting. Resolution Window : Resolve to the province explicitly identified by WHO as experiencing surging weekly Ebola cases in its outbreak assessment publicly reported between September 10 and September 16, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the province.

questions.title: Which film will win the Special Jury Prize at the 2026 Venice Film Festival?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Venice Film Festival’s official announcement of its 2026 award winners. Resolution : Resolve to the film awarded the Special Jury Prize at the 2026 festival, once the winner is publicly announced. Accepted Answer Format : The winning film’s title.

questions.title: Who will win Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election?
questions.background: Okinawa is Japan's southernmost prefecture, where the presence of US military bases is a major political issue.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official results announced by Okinawa's election authorities, either directly or as reported by reliable news organizations. Resolution : The question resolves when the winner of Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election is officially announced. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Which television series will win Outstanding Comedy Series at the 2026 Primetime Emmy Awards?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Television Academy's official winner announcement for Outstanding Comedy Series at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards in 2026. Resolution : Resolve when the winner in this category is formally announced. Accepted Answer Format : The title of the winning television series.

questions.title: Who will win Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series at the 2026 Primetime Emmy Awards?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Television Academy's official winner announcement for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards in 2026. Resolution : Resolve when the winner in this category is formally announced. Accepted Answer Format : The winning actress's full name, not her character's name or the series title.

questions.title: Which television series will win Outstanding Drama Series at the 2026 Primetime Emmy Awards?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Television Academy's official winner announcement for Outstanding Drama Series at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards in 2026. Resolution : Resolve when the winner in this category is formally announced. Accepted Answer Format : The title of the winning television series.

questions.title: Which official will Nigeria's interior minister suspend over the deaths of detained miners in Niger State in September 2026?
questions.background: Nigerian authorities have announced that miners died while being held in custody in Niger State.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Statements from Nigeria's Interior Ministry or reliable news reporting of the ministry's disciplinary decisions. Resolution : Identify the official suspended by the interior minister in connection with the miners' deaths in custody in Niger State. The suspension must be publicly announced by 30 September 2026; calls for disciplinary action without an announced suspension do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The suspended official's full name.
